headline: Halo - the game that made Xbox
title: Halo Combat Evolved Facts | Master Chief and Cortana | Classic Games
video_script: Halo Combat Evolved came out on November fifteenth, two thousand one, for the first Xbox. It was made by Bungie. You play as Master Chief, a super soldier, with the AI Cortana at your side, fighting an alien alliance called the Covenant on a giant ring world called Halo. The PC version came in two thousand three. Did you play Halo? Comment below!
description: Halo: Combat Evolved (November 15, 2001, Xbox; PC 2003) by Bungie: Master Chief and Cortana fight the Covenant on the ring world Halo.
